from companies that could speak a bit more on the real economy. McDonald’s is reporting, as is Kraft Heinz, Costco Wholesale. Walt Disney is set to post results. A slew of tech companies, including Palantir Technologies, and chipmakers including Advanced Micro Devices, are also posting results. The explosive earnings season has continued to serve as a key reason why many investors are bullish. Of the roughly 300 S & P 500 companies that have reported, 85% beat expectations, according to FactSet [...] is expected to have added 87,500 nonfarm payrolls in July, up from 57,000 jobs the previous month, according to FactSet consensus estimates. The unemployment rate is also set to edge higher, to 4.3% from 4.2%. “People are going to have to pay attention to all those numbers more carefully to arrive at their own conclusions,” said Thomas Browne, portfolio manager at Keeley Gabelli Funds.
